title: Asiad: Blu Girls still in medal hunt despite loss to China
summary: The Philippine softball team still has a shot at the podium in the 2026 Asian Games despite suffering an abbreviated 7-0 loss to powerhouse China on Thursday at the Anjo Softball Ground.
